description.value:
Duration constant

When you mark a creature you have marked before, in any previous encounter, every duel bonus you would accumulate against it starts at its maximum value immediately. Your body files opponents the way other people file grudges, and it does not need to be reminded twice.

cinderfall.incomplete: Marking a creature that was marked in any previous encounter starts all duel bonuses at maximum immediately. No rule element persists "has this specific creature been marked before, ever" across encounters -- the mark predicate is confirmed unfireable even within a single encounter, let alone with cross-encounter memory.
